posts.text: Clarification on Individual Reflection Requirements: Your individual reflection for the group project does not need to be a 4-5 paragraph essay. 2 well-developed paragraphs are enough for full credit.

Reminders: You are allowed to have your outline for your exam. Outline format: 8.5x11 sheet, front and back, handwritten or typed (12 font), bullet points not paragraphs. AI usage is not allowed. Ms. Browne will examine all outlines before the exam and may not allow outlines based on content and structure.
